item.title: First thoughts after watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 16
item.description:
I am a light novel reader for this series and this note includes a spoiler.

I watched Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 16, which was the final episode in this season. It was a great episode with a lot of fighting scenes and worth watching as anime.

At first, Horikita found the note that Kiyotaka Ayanokoji will be expelled in I-2, and decided to go there. She met Ibuki and then Amasawa in the middle of the way. And Ibuki left in order to get more points than Horikita. Afterward, Horikita started talking to Amasawa, and Amasawa was just trying to provoke her about not knowing Ayanokoji well enough and tried to block her. She felt it was going to fight so she prepared to fight and Amasawa started. Obviously, Horikita couldn't win against Amasawa; she was thrown with Judo, and then Amasawa kicked her and knocked her down. But Amasawa's goal was to buy her time. Afterward, she stood up and Amasawa tried to punch Ibuki, but Ibuki caught her fist. Well, it's a little weird to me that Amasawa couldn't see Ibuki even though she was in front of her. Anyhow, they started fighting against Amasawa together. Time by time they argued with each other about a few things, and each time, Amasawa just watched them without attacking. It was good because obviously, her purpose wasn't to win against them, or at least she underestimated them. Then Horikita learned something from Amasawa and told Ibuki about it, and then Amasawa suddenly froze and took a hit from both of them. Then Horikita and Ibuki found out she had taken damage on the side of her belly. And Amasawa allowed them to pass by, because she had earned enough time. If that hit had come from Tsukishiro, it would defeat her purpose of being able to stop anyone who was trying to reach the place. Or maybe she didn't do what she was told and he didn't care. In terms of animation, Amasawa's fighting was so smooth as she moved against 2 people, and it was patently obvious she was so agile and powerful in that fight.

Second, Ayanokoji fought against Tsukishiro and another teacher. I forgot who he was. He fought against them and tried to avoid their attacks, standing at a place where a wave of the sea reached his foot on the beach. Were they that strong? He couldn't attack them at all, or he was still just trying to learn how they were attacking. But then, Kiryuin came and joined them without knowing why they were fighting. She was the person who just moved by her curiosity, and the 1st year students tried to kick Ayanokoji out, which made her curious, so she stalked him. She also talked as if she is a lady, but exceptionally, she had fighting or martial arts experience. As a result, Ayanokoji fought against Tsukishiro alone. The fighting scene was, unlike Amasawa and Horikita and Ibuki, unrealistic, and Ayanokoji's movement was like an MC with superpowers. Tsukishiro was strong, and also wicked enough that he had an ace up his sleeve. So he tried to create an opening using sand and attacked, but of course, Ayanokoji figured it out and stopped him by pinning his fingers to Tsukishiro's neck. Then other teachers came and Tsukishiro couldn't fight anymore and he failed. Also, Horikita and Ibuki came and ended there.

spoiler comments of light novels. Well, what's so weird was Horikita didn't figure out anything from this scene in the light novel even after this. That was definitely weird that someone tried to get Ayanokoji expelled and there were only teachers there. She should've been suspicious, especially since she's a smart enough character to be a leader in a class. Also, Kiryuin suddenly came up before this island exam, and came to this very important fighting scene. But if I remember correctly, this was the only scene she was mainly involved with Ayanokoji. She was brought in probably because the author needed a character who moved by her curiosity only, didn't tell secrets to others nor ask anything, and then fought so that Ayanokoji was able to focus on fighting against Tsukishiro. It would've been weird if Tsukishiro had fought against him by himself even though he knew Ayanokoji was a masterpiece in the Whiteroom.
Amasawa disobeyed orders from Tsukishiro a lot, so she couldn't go back to the Whiteroom anymore and she was okay to stay or leave the school. Well, if disobeying many times causes expulsion from the Whiteroom, why not the same for Ayanokoji? Maybe Amasawa wasn't that good there.

Afterward, the exam's results were announced. All of the bottom 5 were from the 3rd year grade, instead of the 1st or 2nd year grades, and Nagumo didn't save them. Well, why were they so bad? Even though they needed to follow Nagumo, some of the 1st years or 2nd years were worse than them. Or simply because the 1st and 2nd year leaders were way better than the 3rd years. Then 3rd place was Sakayanagi, 2nd was Nagumo, and 1st was Koenji. Nagumo was trying to collect the points to that group, so that was the reason why their points were way better than any of the 2nd year or 1st year groups. Still, Sakayanagi's group was good enough to beat other groups despite the fact that she couldn't move. Well, in the ship, Karuizawa thought about the kiss with Ayanokoji and she was like a main heroine here. Also, Ryuen and Sakayanagi talked about some kinds of deals, and Sakayanagi and Ayanokoji talked about similar things. These are the setup for season 5. Horikita just told Ayanokoji that they reached class C and are close to class B now.

Anyway, this is the end of season 4. The island exam was long, and there were a lot of fighting scenes. The animation was good for anyone, like Koenji, Ryuen, Housen, Ayanokoji, and Amasawa. Also, the animation of the island was good enough that we could see how they did it, unlike in the novel where we could just imagine it. Maybe the scene between Ayanokoji and Ichinose was a little over-romanticized, though. And also the leaders battle between Tsubaki and Sakayanagi was a good one. I remember in the light novel, Tsubaki figured out Sakayanagi was behind the scenes, but that scene was cut somehow. Let's wait and see in season 5.

Watched the 2nd time.

I overlooked many things. First, the memo left for Horikita was written by an honest person, because it's not even a code, so everyone can understand what it means. So, very likely Ichinose. But Ichinose didn't show her smile on the ship when she found out something. Maybe there was no scene where she saw him; well, but it was a kind of important scene, so it's going to be included in season 5, I guess.

Second, I overlooked that Amasawa clearly said Horikita was able to take a rest for 5 or 10 minutes while they were fighting.

Also, I didn't notice that when Kiryuin appeared, the BGM changed to hers. This is the kind of character who has her own BGM, which happens in some anime. She might be a favorite character of the production company.

Also, when Horikita came to the beach, Tsukishiro and Shiba had already left, so she couldn't find out and figure out what happened. Ayanokoji's tornado movement to avoid attacks from both Tsukishiro and Shiba, and also doing a front flip, was amazing and unreal.

item.title: First thoughts after watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 14
item.description:
I am a light novel reader for this series and this note includes a spoiler.

I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 14. It started not from Ayanokoji, but from Kiriyama's PoV. Koenji was 2nd place, close to the Nagumo's group, and Kiriyama was sure that Nagumo and he were the only people who could stop Koenji. So 10 or more people in the 3rd years students were trying to follow, negotiate, and get them in the middle of Koenji's way. I don't remember exactly how many details the LN included, but I felt it's not as detailed as anime, so animators really liked Koenji. He was extraordinary, for sure. He can climb up a cliff just by jumps, he slept but only for a short amount of time, because his REM sleep cycle was, what was that? shorter than others? And then, he wasn't scared on the narrow cliff pathway at all while others did. In the first place, the island isn't really a good place for an exam considering how dangerous it is.

Kiriyama couldn't control the group and his group started attacking to Koenji. They wanted to get a reward of A-class's ticket from Nagumo, so they needed an achievement. But they were easily defeated. Koenji definitely attacked some people, but for some people, didn't he just push them? But they couldn't stand up after his attack and he left the place. Kiriyama planned something because he assumed Koenji thought 3rd year students couldn't do anything to him later. I don't remember he was a smart character, though.

By the way, except Koenji, the only 2nd-year group that entered the top 10 was Sakayanagi's, with Ichinose, and they were just rank 10, so they weren't actually that good compared to the 3rd years students. Maybe there is a spoiler here for the 3rd year students so I don't say the details. But still, was Nagumo's ability that much higher compared to all of 2nd years leaders? I didn't feel so after reading all volumes of the 2nd year's LNs.

On the other hand, Ayanokoji met some students from class B, Shiina and Ishizaki and worked together. At a night, Nanase somehow figured out his place and came to his tent and then shared 1st years' plan.

3 days ago, she met with Housen and another student happened to come to him and then gave him the transceiver. That was from Utomiya, and they argued before reaching to the conclusion. Housen somehow knew Tsubaki was near him and she persuaded him to expel a few students who work alone like Ayanokoji and that's what Housen wanted. Tsubaki understood the essence of characters pretty well and gave them what they want, and she also achieved what she wanted. She also noticed somehow Nanase was around Housen. This woman was actually a lot like Ayanokoji.

Then Yagami came to Utomiya and Tsubaki and gave them the information about the place of Ayanokoji. But Tsubaki knew it beforehand so Yagami couldn't get any reward of expelling Ayanokoji. Utomiya also was suspicious to Yagami because he broke his wristband twice already though Utomiya himself did it only once. Probably that once was deliberate one so he was suspicious to Yagami. Then Yagami left that scene, and Tsubaki using transceivers to surround Ayanokoji. By looking at these, at least Tsubaki seemed to be really from the White room for sure. And what did Yagami do here?

On the other hand, Ayanokoji used a GPS feature and he identified the locations of Yagami, Utomiya, and Tsubaki somehow and noticed 1st years students are surrounded. He didn't even think they were dangerous enough to change his plan. In the 1st place, how did he know where each student was, even though he didn't meet any of them, by just using a GPS search? Did he know enough about 1st years students at that point? Especially, Tsubaki, Utomiya, and Yagami didn't do anything before the exam.

Anyway, everybody knows something big will happen in the next episode.

Watched again. Mikitani and others were really mob enemies who are willing to violent as usual and were easily be defeated. A woman in the class B said Ayanokoji was harmless and I know that's how most students thought he was, but I really felt they were terribly dense from the watcher's view. What happened between Tsubaki and Utomiya? I think even til the end of 2nd years' volumes, they didn't talk anything. And until here, this show really showed that she was suspicious as the one from the White room, considering how badly she wanted to expel, and she didn't care if she was expelled.

Well, but animators really enjoyed animating Koenji. They did whatever they want for him to make him stronger and more agile.

item.title: First thoughts after watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 15
item.description:
I am a light novel reader for this series and this note includes a spoiler.

I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 15. This was actually great episode to see our girl Sakayanagi made it a lot the leaders in the 2nd year did pretty well. In the last episode, I thought 2nd years grade didn't do pretty well like Sakayanagi in the exam, but I forgot she spent time to help Ayanokoji and also Ichino sent out of control so kinda makes sense, it might make sense?

Anyway, in the episode, 1st year students tried to surround Ayanokoji. Obviously he was extraordinary physiques so even he thought there were more numbers than he had expected, he was able to dodge them easily. And then he was blocked by other 2nd years students from any classes because Sakayanagi helped him. Sakayanagi and Ichino's classes coordinated in this exam, and Ryuen also agreed to help, so there were really all classes, except Ayanokoji's class, I guess. I bet he didn't talk to Horikita, so no way class C knew this. Tsubaki also expected him to dodge them and she asked Housen to wait for him. So Housen really looked glad to fight him, but then Ryuen came and they started fighting. The fight was, much more brutal than the previous episode of Koenji or the episode of Ayanokoji vs Ryuen. In the first place, Housen's fist was so strong so each punch caused bleeding Ryuen. Housen hit Ryuen's face, cheek, and stomach, and Ryuen even bled from his mouth. That's very non high school student, and he sure should've been knocked out or dead. He was tough. Also, Housen didn't get most of hits from Ryuen. However, Ishizaki and Albert intercepted Housen and they holded Housen's arms down on the ground. Then Ryuen ground and pound him. Housen also bled and also his left eye had bruise. This might be the most violent fighting scene in Youjitsu? So for someone who likes actions or fighting, this might be a good episode.

Then Ayanokoji talked to Sakayanagi by a transceiver. He owed much more than what she owed to him, which she liked to have and she enjoyed talking. And she noticed Ichinose was trying to meet him, and share it to him.

Sakayanagi told Ichinose's place to him so he went to meet her. Ichinose also found him across a stream and they met on a rock on a stream. Was it the same in the LN? It was a very dramatic and beautiful scene, but i felt like why don't they move somewhere more stable. But anyway, Ichinose was so rush and needed to tell what she knew. And she told him that Tsukishiro was trying to sabotage him in the I-2. And she was threatened by Tsukishiro to expel her classmates if she told about this to Ayanokoji. Then she was rush to come there and was trying to tell whatever her mind was, so she told him that she loved him. She was confused by herself but she understood how she felt to him. He didn't answer yes or no and just wanted her to wait because he was with Kei. Well, Ichinose around these episodes were really great and still one of the main heroines.

Anyway, then he was trying to go to the point Tsukishiro prepared but in the middle of the way, Nagumo came. Nagumo was really interested with him, but Ayanokoji didn't care about Nagumo. This was the time when Ayanokoji said that he actually had respects to him that he controlled students in the entire grade. Anyway, Nagumo was trying to intercept him but Ayanokoji completely knocked him out.

The end of Ayanokoji's eyes became green, and Ryuen got red, so Ayanokoji's eyes really isn't like normal and Ryuen's eyes are really fighting spirits, I guess.

Watched 2nd time.

The fights between Ryuen and Housen was it was one side game but still Ryuen won against the stronger opponent in this episode. By the way, Ryuen said fighting him was to earn money, but was it from Ayanokoji? Did they talk about what was reward in the volumes later?

Tsubaki said she should've done by herself after losing her operation, but how could she win Ayanokoji by herself. She was smart but seems to be confident or might be arrogant. And Yagumo in this exam was so useless which seemed not to do anything, at least on the surface.

How did Ayanokoji feel when Ichinose confessed to him? In my brain, I thought it was the moment of just according to keikakku.

About Nagumo, I remembered I had thought Nagumo was a strong and evil character that even Ayanokoji would take time to take him down, until this episode but I got him underdog in this episode. And it wasn't changed a bit in the anime, too. Maybe in Anime, it's not drawn enough that he was actually a really strong leader so far, though.

item.title: First thoughts after watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 13
item.description:
I am a light novel reader for this series and this note includes a spoiler.

I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 13. I finally liked Amasawa in Anime. I didn't do in LN so much, but with watching animation for her, she is an emotional and mysterious girl, and that's nice.

Anyway, Amasawa came to Ayanokoji and Nanase's fighting place. At first, Nananse didn't trust her at all because she saw someone with hair like Amasawa back when Kinoshita was hit by the cliff. Well, it makes sense. Who can trust her? Then she talked to Ayanokoji alone and revealed herself that she was from the White room. And then she left. Why did she come to him? I had no idea, but probably shouldn't think. If I remember correctly, it was not that important. Perhaps because she came near him and couldn't stop meeting with him and talking about herself.

Then, Ayanokoji left Nanase to Housen, and then he was trying to reach out to Sakayanagi while taking an exam. He met Ibuki, who doesn't like the support from him, and also met Kiryuin. Actually, Kiryuin's scene was hilarious. It was a way better than I remembered, because an emotion less Ayanokoji was confused with how she reacted with his joke. She is basically a Koenji in 3rd year grade as a woman.

Then he met with Shiranami or some sorts. I forgot who she was but she was the person in Ichinose's class and talked about the relationship between Ichinose and him. It was very short conversation. Probably there was more in a LN, or maybe because there is talking in themselves that were not animated. I think the important thing here is that they had a transceiver which he and Horikita discussed in this episode, and used it to talk with Sakayanagi.

The later part of an exam is about to begin, and it's going to be more interesting than the earlier part.

item.title: First thoughts after watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 12
item.description:
I am a light novel reader for this series and this note includes a spoiler.

I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 12. This episode was about 2 things. First, the Nanase finally lured Ayanokoji into a place where nobody is there and started fighting against him. When I watched in English Dub, it's a little bit hard to understand when she tried to behave like.. what is his name? Eiichiro? But fighting scene was a good that Ayanokoji is as expectedly overwhelming her. I still don't feel this scene and the motivation of Nanase doesn't really make sense, but she is 15 or 16 so make sense that she wants to put someone for her anger.

The another scene is, behind the scene of Ayanokoji and Nanase, Kushida was trying to take a picture of them, so they can expel him. She was asked by Yagami, so he showed he outsmarted her completely. However, Amasawa found her and obviously she couldn't deal with Amasawa at all. Her physique is, as usual, extraordinary, and showed, what was that? Judo? so Amasawa even throw her. With this physique and her obsession to Ayanokoji, which seems even crazy, it's so obvious that she is from the White room, but for readers, they don't know why she didn't try him to get expelled.

The final scene was Ichinose, who happen to find the secret conversation to kick out Ayanokoji between Tsukishiro and a man, and she was intimidated not to tell what she heard. Ichinose is treated like one of the main heroine here instead of Horikita. Well, I know what's going to come, so I wouldn't say that much.

This episode has a little action and also reveal a little truth so it was a good one.

item.title: First thoughts after watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 11
item.description:
I am a light novel reader for this series and this note includes a spoiler.

I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 11. Overall, finally a story started getting interested in.

The episode started from the scene that alarms were going off without stopping and then Ayanokoji, Nanase, Ike, and others found out they're from Komiya's one. They knocked out and was unconscious, and they found out they were falled from the cliff, but Shinohara wasn't there who was supposed to be the same group as Komiya. Then after that, Ike tried to find and found out Shinohara above the cliff, who hid because she saw somebody kicked Komiya and pushed them down, and she was scared, which is actually pretty scary if you're only one person out there in a dark, and someone would kick you but you don't know why they do. Then teachers somehow didn't believe Shinohara and they sent two students away from the exam.

The rest of the episode is somehow, related to this incident. One is that Nanase somehow started running and found someone, who looks obviously Amane, but Amane didn't stop and Nanase even couldn't catch up to her. Then Ike tried to be cool and started working together with Shinohara. Ayanokoj was trying to get a help from Ryuen, Sakayanagi, and Ichinose for Shinohara, obviously, by something. I honestly don't remember what it will be. Ask Shinohara to join a group of... which? Sakayanagi, but then talking to Ryuen for... helping his class, too? One scene it was cut from LN was that why Sakayangi is there. Obviously, Sakayangi couldn't move but she was exempted from joining each exam in the island and still can get a point, but there was no such small talk.

While Ayanokoji was trying to find them, they also met Koenji, who was the 4th in the rank. There is a little interaction with them, but not so many animation. I hope they will have in the exam later.

item.title: Brain dump after watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 9
item.description:
I am a light novel reader for this series and this note includes a spoiler.

I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 9. I may already remember scenes incorrectly throughout this series, or maybe an anime changed the original script. For example, there was a short scene of Nanase's past. How did Ayanokoji involve with someone outside of Whiteroom? Or maybe did this scene try to show Nanase was actually related to the Whiteroom? Also, somehow, Horikita knew that Ayanokoji and Kushida had a deal so he needs to give points. I remembered this was far later than this episode is, so I'm not really sure the intent is here.

As for the episode, at last, the new exam started. Tsukishiro's announcement that some amount of violences are allowed sounds really terrible here. And even no other teachers did not complaint or stop him, so that is very much like that school.

Then the island itself is very big and where Ayanokoji went in this episode is really in a jungle. It's really great way to show on the anime and it also shows that there is really a risk. A wrist for health checks and warnings really isn't enough in that size of the island honestly. I forgot how the island's exam when they were on the 1st year was, but now thinking about this exam, the jungle is so big and this exam looks so anime size. Well, cruise is also really big.

item.title: Watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 4
item.description:
I am a light novel reader for this series

I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 4. This episode was one of the episodes I was waiting for in this season the most. Turned out that it was a little bit too fast after Ayanokoji found out what was Housen up to. I expected Horikita was more like in a panic when he got a knife in his left hand and also Sudo was almost shocked, and also they needed to take care of its bleeding. These entire reactions were removed and I felt they were too calm down even though they were just high school students in that school, except maybe Housen only. His reaction was good and maybe a director or producer thought that was enough? Also, I remembered he would say that he couldn't understand how Ayanokoji was so good before stabbing his knife, and that was one phrase I liked.

Besides, the exam showed that Ayanokoji's math score was 100 and better than anyone else, but there was no explanation how good it was, so the episode skipped a lot I felt.

Housen's fighting with Sudo and Horikita was kinda good, especially Horikita can actually fight and she could even do jump spinning kick. They still couldn't even have a chance against Housen, though. In this season, there will be more fighting scenes so maybe they'll be interested in.

Other than that, this episode was mostly like preparing what's going to happen next, with the discussion between Horikita's class and Housen's class in the next episode.

item.title: Watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 2
item.description:
I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 2. In this episode, Horikita and Ayanokoji were trying to overcome the challenge on the next exam overall. Sakayanagi was also trying to do it by the information tactic by taking advantage of class A. What's funny was that compared to them, Ryuen and his classmates were only in a private Karaoke room and talked like he were a king, and ate a popcorn and drunk something like coke. If they're in a bar and drink a wine or wisky, maybe that matches with their characters. And I forgot how useful the 1st year will be through the end of the year and how much the assessment of Ryuen actually was useful.

Besides, Amasawa showed up at the first time in this episode, and she was really creepy woman. When I read the light novel, I guessed this girl was surely from the white room because it was so illogical of what she was doing, but also it might be just a confusing character for readers because Ayanokoji thought the same thing.

In the animation, I noticed the characters were drawn with intentional dashed or thin black lines. It is probably to avoid having clear boundaries of people by those lines because there are no such lines for real humans, but it gives me like an itchy feeling, because the line doesn't show clear distinction.

In the opening, in the previous episode, I guessed the noises on the eyes on each character might be whether they are candidates from Whiteroom or not, but in that case, Tsukishiro must not have it, and also, some 2nd year grades students also have the noises even those in the class D. Maybe these are just drawn on the scenes of Ayanokoji's views and he views most people with that view regardless of a student from the Whiteroom or not.

Ending is, what the heck. Classroom leaders do not matter in the ending, characters are from 1st year and 2nd year, and Ayanokoji is on a throne. Then there is a snake, venomous snake, I guess, and all got dead without any flesh by that venom. No idea what it meant, though. The king Ayanokoji himself is venomous and will kill everybody? Another possibility is that there is a student from the Whiteroom, but they have nothing to do with anyone but Ayanokoji.

item.title: Watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 1
item.description:
I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 1. I read the light novel in 2nd year's arc.

I don't remember in the previous seasons that much, but I felt strange to hear the voice of Chabashira, and a little bit about Ikeda. It looks like Chabashira's voice actress is Jennifer Alyx, and seems hasn't been changed since season 1 so I'll get used to it.

Throughout the entire episode, it's funny to see the Housen and it's character design, considering that he is 15 or 16 years old, perhaps, as the 1st year in the high school, but he is matured in the anime level. When Ryuen just came to Housen and was trying to leave there without not doing anything was more like scenario-based story, so that the sole purpose is to show the relationship between Ryuen and Housen and how Housen is intimidating. Ryuen and Sakayanagi often do these things so I shouldn't care those things that much, though.

The ending of this season is good for both of animation and song. What the noises of eyes on each character mean? Some characters do not have like leaders in each class in the 2nd year, but many of others have. Maybe those are candidates from the whiteroom in Kiyotaka's mind. Need to double check the animation.
